data.name: Munadhirah
data.gender_notes: Munadhirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is firm and steadfast in her beliefs and actions. The name Munadhirah carries the meaning “Firm, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Munadhirah usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a strong and determined woman of faith
data.etymology: Munadhirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munadhirah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

A person named Munadhirah is believed to possess the qualities of patience, perseverance, and unwavering commitment to the divine will. The name serves as a reminder of the importance of staying grounded in faith and remaining steadfast in the face of challenges and trials.
